test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following stated in 1902, India was not ruled for its benefit, but rather for the benefit of its conquerors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annie Besant**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annie Besant** stated in 1902 that India was not ruled for its benefit, but rather for the benefit of its conquerors.
 
• Annie Besant was a prominent British socialist, theosophist, women's rights activist, writer, and orator.
 
• She played a significant role in the Indian independence movement and was a staunch advocate for self-rule for India.
 
• Besant became the first woman president of the Indian National Congress in 1917.
 
• Her efforts and dedication to the Indian cause earned her a place of respect in Indian history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** was an Indian nationalist, teacher, and an independence activist. He was one of the first leaders of the Indian Independence Movement.
 
• **Lala Lajpat Rai** was an Indian freedom fighter who played a pivotal role in the Indian Independence movement. He was popularly known as Punjab Kesari.
 
• **Sarojini Naidu** was an Indian independence activist, poet, and politician. She was the first Indian woman to become the president of the Indian National Congress and the first woman to serve as a governor in independent India.
